name: Rajasthan
highCourt: Rajasthan High Court (Principal Seat Jodhpur, Bench Jaipur)
summary: India's largest state by geographic area (10.4% of country). Home to the Thar Desert, Aravalli Range (world's oldest fold mountains), Hill Forts of Rajasthan (UNESCO), and rich Rajput history.
dance: Ghoomar, Kalbelia (UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage), Bhavai, Chari
festivals: Pushkar Camel Fair, Desert Festival (Jaisalmer), Gangaur, Teej
rivers: Chambal, Banas, Luni (inland drainage), Sabarmati, Mahi
minerals: Zinc & Lead (Zawar - sole producer in India), Marble (Makrana), Copper (Khetri)
monuments: Hill Forts (Chittorgarh, Kumbhalgarh, Ranthambore, Amber, Jaisalmer, Gagron), Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar, Mehrangarh Fort
nationalParks: Ranthambore, Sariska, Keoladeo Ghana (Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary, UNESCO), Desert National Park, Mukundra Hills
schemes: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Dawa Yojana, Bhamashah / Jan Aadhaar, Chiranjeevi Health Insurance

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Rajasthan.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Jaipur (Pink City). Rajasthan covers a geographic area of 342,239 sq km across 50 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Chambal, Banas, Luni (inland drainage), Sabarmati, Mahi.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: India's largest state by geographic area (10.4% of country). Home to the Thar Desert, Aravalli Range (world's oldest fold mountains), Hill Forts of Rajasthan (UNESCO), and rich Rajput history.

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which is the highest peak in Rajasthan and the Aravalli mountain range?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान और अरावली पर्वतमाला की सर्वोच्च पर्वत चोटी कौन सी है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Guru Shikhar in Mount Abu (Sirohi district) is the highest peak of Rajasthan with an elevation of 1,722 meters.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: माउंट आबू (सिरोही जिला) में स्थित गुरु शिखर 1,722 मीटर की ऊंचाई के साथ राजस्थान और अरावली की सबसे ऊंची चोटी है।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Which river is known as the only perennial river originating within Rajasthan, and has Bisalpur Dam constructed on it?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान से पूर्णतः प्रवाहित होने वाली और जिस पर बीसलपुर बांध निर्मित है, वह प्रमुख नदी कौन सी है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Banas River (Van ki Asha) originates from the Khamnore hills in Rajsamand; Bisalpur Dam in Tonk is built on it.

practiceQuestions.explanationHi: जीण माता का पवित्र मंदिर सीकर जिले के रेवासा गांव के पास स्थित है।
practiceQuestions.hint: Focus on places monuments in Rajasthan.
practiceQuestions.hintHi: राजस्थान के places monuments पर ध्यान दें।

practiceQuestions.questionText: The 36-km long continuous protective perimeter wall of which fort is known as the Great Wall of India?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: राजस्थान के किस किले की 36 किमी लंबी दीवार को 'द ग्रेट वॉल ऑफ इंडिया' कहा जाता है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Kumbhalgarh Fort in Rajsamand, built by Rana Kumbha, features the second-longest continuous wall in the world.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: राणा कुंभा द्वारा निर्मित कुंभलगढ़ दुर्ग की 36 किमी लंबी प्राचीर दुनिया में चीन की दीवार के बाद दूसरी सबसे लंबी दीवार है।

practiceQuestions.questionText: Taragarh Fort (Star Fort), commanding the historic city of Ajmer, was built on which hill?
practiceQuestions.questionTextHi: अजमेर में स्थित प्रसिद्ध तारागढ़ किला किस पहाड़ी पर बना हुआ है?
practiceQuestions.explanation: Taragarh Fort was built by Ajaypal Chauhan on Garh Beetli hill, earning it the name Garh Beetli.
practiceQuestions.explanationHi: तारागढ़ दुर्ग का निर्माण अजयपाल चौहान ने बीठली पहाड़ी पर कराया था, इसलिए इसे 'गढ़ बीठली' भी कहते हैं।
